items.title: Smulyan interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2010
items.q: I had the great pleasure of recording with Christian McBride and Billy Drummond and we did a trio record called “Hidden Treasures.”

ctx.x: In some time. I read a small thing about — that you enjoy playing with just drums and bass. © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -16-

I do. I love playing — that’s my chosen environment. I had the great pleasure of recording with Christian McBride and Billy Drummond and we did a trio record called “Hidden Treasures.” And the freedom in that, without a piano or without a guitar is, for me, just magic. Because I just feel free to kind of go and take the music in any direction, where I can kind of go where I want without being kind of locked in with chords. And that’s hard work too, because it’s hard to stop, it’s like kind of you have to play all…
Yeah. I suppose you’re asking quite a bit from your audience.
